text: Find the x-intercept of the line \(y = -7x + 49\).

A line has gradient \(-\frac{2}{7}\). Find the gradient of a line perpendicular to it.

explanation:
Parallel lines have equal gradients.

The given line has gradient 7, so any parallel line also has gradient 7.
